papers.title: Low-pressure insufflation with warmed and humidified CO2 versus cold and dry CO2 in laparoscopic colorectal surgery: Protocol for the PAROS 3 randomized controlled trial
papers.journal_full: Colorectal disease : the official journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Denost Q, Beyer-Berjot L, Soubirou J, De Cazes Y, Pastene B, Blanc M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Low-pressure pneumoperitoneum (LPP) has been shown to reduce postoperative pain and analgesic requirements after laparoscopic colorectal surgery. In parallel, warm and humidified carbon dioxide (WHCO2) insufflation provides a more physiological peritoneal environment and may further improve postoperative recovery. However, the combined effect of LPP and WHCO2 has not been specifically evaluated in colorectal surgery.
AIM: To determine whether the addition of WHCO2 to LPP further reduces postoperative pain and opioid consumption compared with LPP alone in patients undergoing laparoscopic colorectal resection.
METHODS: PAROS3 is a French prospective, bicentric, randomized, controlled superiority trial. Adult patients scheduled for elective laparoscopic or robot-assisted colorectal resection under LPP (5-8 mmHg) will be randomized (1:1) to receive either WHCO2 insufflation (experimental group) or standard cold and dry CO2 (control group). The study is double-blinded for patients and evaluators of the primary endpoint, and open-label for the "operator" surgeon. The primary endpoint is the proportion of patients with a visual analogue scale (VAS) pain score ≤3 at 24 h after surgery, without consumption of level II or III analgesics. Secondary endpoints include operating time, conversion rates, perioperative haemodynamic and temperature variations, inflammatory markers, postoperative complications, oncological quality, length of stay, analgesic consumption up to 30 days, and quality of life at 3 months. Analysis will be performed on an intention-to-treat basis. A total of 148 patients are planned for inclusion.
TRIAL STATUS: Recruitment is ongoing. Protocol version 3.1, August 25, 2025.
REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05934981.

papers.title_zh: 腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術中低壓充氣使用加溫加濕 CO2 與低溫乾燥 CO2 之比較：PAROS 3 隨機對照試驗計畫書
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：低壓氣腹（LPP）已被證實可減少腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術後疼痛及止痛藥需求。同時，加溫加濕二氧化碳（WHCO2）充氣可提供更符合生理狀態的腹膜環境，並可能進一步改善術後恢復。然而，LPP 與 WHCO2 的合併效果尚未在大腸直腸手術中受到專門評估。
目的：釐清接受腹腔鏡大腸直腸切除術的病人，在 LPP 基礎上加入 WHCO2，相較於單用 LPP，是否能進一步減少術後疼痛及鴉片類藥物用量。
方法：PAROS3 是一項法國前瞻性、雙中心、隨機、對照優效性試驗。預定在 LPP（5–8 mmHg）下接受擇期腹腔鏡或機器人輔助大腸直腸切除術的成年病人，將以 1:1 隨機分配接受 WHCO2 充氣（實驗組）或標準低溫乾燥 CO2（對照組）。本研究對病人及主要終點評估者採雙盲設計，但對執刀外科醫師採開放標籤設計。主要終點為術後 24 小時視覺類比量表（VAS）疼痛分數 ≤3，且未使用第二級或第三級止痛藥的病人比例。次要終點包括手術時間、轉換手術方式的比率、圍手術期血流動力學與體溫變化、發炎指標、術後併發症、腫瘤學品質、住院天數、術後至第 30 天的止痛藥用量，以及術後 3 個月的生活品質。分析將依意向治療（ITT）原則進行。預計共納入 148 名病人。
試驗狀態：持續收案中。試驗計畫書版本為 3.1，日期為 2025 年 8 月 25 日。
註冊：ClinicalTrials.gov：NCT05934981。

papers.title: The Effects of Pelvic Radiation on Ileal-Anal Pouches: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract: Restorative proctocolectomy with ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (IPAA) is the gold-standard treatment for ulcerative colitis and familial adenomatous polyposis. Pelvic radiation for co-existing malignancies has been associated with pouch complications, yet guidance is still limited. This review synthesized current evidence on effects of pelvic radiation in patients with IPAA. A systematic search of Embase, MEDLINE, and Scopus was conducted in February 2025 using IPAA and pelvic-radiation terms. Eligible studies included patients who underwent IPAA and received pelvic radiation before or after surgery, and reported a pouch-related clinical outcome. Twelve studies (2004-2024) met inclusion criteria, comprising 101 patients who received radiation (83 external beam radiation therapy [EBRT], 18 brachytherapy). The pooled pouchitis rate was 28% (95% CI, 24%-34%). Complications were more common when radiation was delivered after IPAA than before: pouchitis occurred in 53.7% versus 7.7%, and pouch failure in 39.0% versus 3.8%. Brachytherapy was associated with numerically lower pouchitis (16.7% versus 25.3%) and pouch failure (11.1% versus 18.1%) rates than EBRT; however, differences were not statistically significant. Pelvic radiation in patients with IPAA is associated with adverse outcomes. Radiation timing and modality should be considered when balancing oncologic benefit against pouch function.

papers.title_zh: 骨盆放射治療對迴腸肛門儲袋的影響：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 合併迴腸儲袋肛門吻合術（IPAA）的重建性全大腸直腸切除術，是潰瘍性結腸炎與家族性腺瘤性息肉症的黃金標準治療。針對合併惡性腫瘤所施行的骨盆放射治療，與儲袋併發症有關，但相關指引仍有限。本回顧整合目前關於骨盆放射治療對 IPAA 病人影響的證據。研究於2025年2月，以 IPAA 與骨盆放射治療相關詞彙，系統性搜尋 Embase、MEDLINE 及 Scopus。符合資格的研究須納入接受 IPAA、於手術前或手術後接受骨盆放射治療的病人，並報告儲袋相關臨床結果。共有12篇研究（2004至2024年）符合納入條件，涵蓋101名接受放射治療的病人，其中83名接受體外放射治療（EBRT），18名接受近接治療。合併估計的儲袋炎發生率為28%（95%信賴區間，24%–34%）。相較於 IPAA 術前接受放射治療，術後接受放射治療者的併發症較常見：儲袋炎發生率分別為53.7%與7.7%，儲袋失敗率分別為39.0%與3.8%。相較於 EBRT，近接治療的儲袋炎發生率（16.7%相較於25.3%）及儲袋失敗率（11.1%相較於18.1%）在數值上較低，但差異未達統計顯著。IPAA 病人接受骨盆放射治療與不良結果有關。權衡腫瘤治療效益與儲袋功能時，應考量放射治療的時機與方式。

papers.title: Comparative outcomes of robotic and laparoscopic right colectomy with intracorporeal anastomosis for curative-intent right-sided colonic neoplasia: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Anwar S, Mirza W, Amin I, Ahsan K, Siddique A, Khan H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Robotic right colectomy may facilitate complex intracorporeal dissection and reconstruction; however, previous comparative syntheses often combined laparoscopic extracorporeal anastomosis with robotic intracorporeal anastomosis. This imbalance makes it difficult to determine whether reported differences reflect the surgical platform or the reconstructive technique. We therefore compared robotic and laparoscopic right colectomy only in studies in which intracorporeal anastomosis was planned in both groups.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from the inception to April 12, 2026. Records were deduplicated and screened in Covidence. Four non-randomized observational comparative studies were included. The primary outcome was study-defined overall postoperative morbidity, with definitions and ascertainment windows varying among studies. Secondary outcomes included operative time, conversion to open surgery, anastomotic leak, hospital stay, lymph-node harvest, and mortality. Mortality and long-term oncological outcomes were summarized narratively when comparable effect estimates were unavailable. Random-effects models, ROBINS-I, and GRADE were used for quantitative outcomes.
RESULTS: Four studies involving 977 patients (603 robotic and 374 laparoscopic) were included. Overall postoperative morbidity occurred in 142/603 robotic and 107/374 laparoscopic patients (RR 0.84, 95% CI 0.67-1.05). No statistically significant differences were identified for conversion to open surgery (7/603 vs. 8/374; RR 0.91, 95% CI 0.13-6.33), anastomotic leak (16/603 vs. 11/374; RR 0.88, 95% CI 0.41-1.89), hospital stay (MD - 0.47 days, 95% CI - 1.00 to 0.06), or lymph node harvest (MD - 0.55 nodes, 95% CI - 3.16 to 2.06). Operative time was non-significantly longer with robotics in the primary analysis (MD 39.69 min, 95% CI - 2.19 to 81.57; I²=96%); the exploratory leave-one-out result remained heterogeneous and study-dependent.
CONCLUSIONS: This exploratory synthesis of four non-randomized studies found no statistically significant short-term advantage of robotic over laparoscopic right colectomy when intracorporeal anastomosis was planned in both groups. These findings do not establish equivalence or exclude clinically important benefits or harms. Platform selection should therefore remain individualized according to surgeon experience, institutional workflow, resource availability, and patient and procedural complexity.

papers.title_zh: 以根治為目的之右側結腸腫瘤採機器人與腹腔鏡右半結腸切除併體內吻合的結果比較：經GRADE評估之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：機器人右半結腸切除術可能有助於複雜的體內剝離與重建；然而，過去的比較性證據整合經常將腹腔鏡體外吻合與機器人體內吻合混合比較。這種不平衡使人難以判斷，所報告的差異究竟反映手術平台，還是重建技術的影響。因此，我們僅納入兩組均計畫採用體內吻合的研究，比較機器人與腹腔鏡右半結腸切除術。
方法：搜尋PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus及Web of Science，範圍自資料庫建置起至2026年4月12日。文獻紀錄於Covidence中去除重複並進行篩選。共納入4篇非隨機觀察性比較研究。主要結果為各研究自行定義的整體術後併發症，各研究的定義與確認事件的時間窗並不一致。次要結果包括手術時間、轉開腹手術、吻合口洩漏、住院天數、淋巴結取得數及死亡。若無可比較的效應估計值，則以敘述方式彙整死亡與長期腫瘤學結果。針對量化結果，採用隨機效應模型、ROBINS-I及GRADE進行分析與評估。
結果：共納入4篇研究、977名病人，其中603名接受機器人手術，374名接受腹腔鏡手術。整體術後併發症發生於機器人組142/603名病人，以及腹腔鏡組107/374名病人（RR 0.84，95% CI 0.67–1.05）。轉開腹手術（7/603 vs. 8/374；RR 0.91，95% CI 0.13–6.33）、吻合口洩漏（16/603 vs. 11/374；RR 0.88，95% CI 0.41–1.89）、住院天數（平均差−0.47天，95% CI −1.00至0.06）及淋巴結取得數（平均差−0.55顆，95% CI −3.16至2.06）均未發現統計上顯著差異。在主要分析中，機器人手術時間較長，但未達統計顯著（平均差39.69分鐘，95% CI −2.19至81.57；I²=96%）；探索性的逐一排除研究分析結果仍具有異質性，且受到個別研究影響。
結論：這項納入4篇非隨機研究的探索性證據整合發現，當兩組均計畫採用體內吻合時，機器人相較於腹腔鏡右半結腸切除術，未呈現統計上顯著的短期優勢。這些結果並未確立兩者等效，也無法排除具有臨床重要性的效益或傷害。因此，手術平台的選擇仍應依外科醫師經驗、機構工作流程、資源可近性，以及病人與手術的複雜程度個別決定。

papers.title: Metabolic disease engineers the colorectal cancer ecosystem
papers.abstract: Obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2D) increase colorectal cancer (CRC) risk, yet the mechanisms linking systemic metabolic dysfunction to carcinogenesis are usually considered independently. I propose that metabolic disease can act as an ecosystem engineer, altering the selective conditions in which neoplastic cells emerge and evolve. Nutrient availability, adipose dysfunction, metabolic-epigenetic coupling, immunometabolic rewiring, microbial remodeling, and bile acid metabolism interact across the colonic environment, redistributing metabolic fitness among epithelial, immune, and microbial populations. These interactions may establish a self-reinforcing ecosystem that favors metabolically adaptable clones and reduces constraints on their persistence. Metabolic dysfunction may thus alter which cellular populations can most effectively exploit available resources and evade antitumor surveillance. This hypothesis predicts that tumors with similar molecular characteristics may exist within biologically distinct environments according to the host metabolic state, and therefore could show differential responses to immune activity and therapy. Integrating systemic metabolic parameters, including adiposity distribution, insulin resistance, glycemic control, circulating metabolites, and microbial features, with molecular tumor classification could reveal distinct CRC ecological states and host-tumor dependencies. Such metabolic stratification could generate opportunities for personalized prevention and therapy by identifying vulnerabilities that remain obscured by current tumor-centric classification.

papers.title: Loop colostomy offers comparable short-term surgical outcomes with fewer metabolic complications than loop ileostomy after laparoscopic low anterior resection post-total neoadjuvant therapy: developing-country perspective
papers.authors: Dabous A, Ghanayem M, Al Matairi A, Rajab I, Turfa R, Amarin R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Defunctioning stomas are standard in low anterior resection (LAR) posttotal neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) to mitigate anastomotic complications. While loop ileostomy is common, it poses significant metabolic risks. This study investigates whether loop colostomy may reduce renal and electrolyte complications, without compromising surgical or stoma reversal outcomes.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 97 patients with rectal cancer treated at King Hussein Cancer Center (January 2020 to November 2024) who underwent TNT followed by LAR with a defunctioning stoma (ileostomy, n = 57; colostomy, n = 40). Primary outcomes were acute kidney injury (AKI) and hyponatremia. Secondary outcomes included stoma-related and closure-related complications. Data were compared using chi-squared, Mann-Whitney U-test, and Kaplan-Meier analysis.
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were comparable, except for higher baseline creatinine in ileostomy patients (p = 0.002). Ileostomy was associated with more AKI (35.1% versus 2.5%, p < 0.001) and hyponatremia (57.8% versus 20.0%, p < 0.001) with greater stoma output (p < 0.001). Skin excoriation was more frequent with ileostomy (24.5% versus 5.0%, p = 0.011), while colostomy had higher stoma prolapse (22.5% versus 1.7%, p < 0.001). Other postoperative outcomes were similar. However, blood loss during stoma reversal was greater with ileostomy (p < 0.001). Kaplan-Meier analysis showed no difference in time to closure (median 84 versus 85 days, p = 0.491). In multivariate analysis, ileostomy remained associated with AKI and hyponatremia after adjustment for the included covariates.
CONCLUSIONS: Loop colostomy may represent an alternative to loop ileostomy after LAR following TNT, with fewer metabolic complications and comparable surgical outcomes, despite a higher prolapse risk.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：全程前導治療（TNT）後接受低前位切除術（LAR）時，保護性造口是減輕吻合口併發症的標準做法。雖然環狀迴腸造口很常見，卻伴隨顯著的代謝風險。本研究探討環狀結腸造口是否能減少腎臟與電解質併發症，同時不影響手術或造口關閉的結果。
方法：我們回溯分析侯賽因國王癌症中心於2020年1月至2024年11月治療的97名直腸癌病人，這些病人均接受TNT，隨後接受LAR及保護性造口（迴腸造口57人；結腸造口40人）。主要結果為急性腎損傷（AKI）及低血鈉。次要結果包括造口相關及造口關閉相關併發症。資料採卡方檢定、Mann–Whitney U檢定及Kaplan–Meier分析進行比較。
結果：除迴腸造口病人的基線肌酸酐較高（p＝0.002）外，兩組基線特徵相近。迴腸造口與較多AKI（35.1%對2.5%，p＜0.001）、低血鈉（57.8%對20.0%，p＜0.001）及較大的造口排出量（p＜0.001）相關。迴腸造口的皮膚糜爛較常見（24.5%對5.0%，p＝0.011），而結腸造口的造口脫垂較多（22.5%對1.7%，p＜0.001）。其他術後結果相近。然而，迴腸造口關閉手術的失血量較多（p＜0.001）。Kaplan–Meier分析顯示，至造口關閉的時間無差異（中位數84對85天，p＝0.491）。多變項分析中，校正納入模型的共變項後，迴腸造口仍與AKI及低血鈉相關。
結論：TNT後接受LAR時，環狀結腸造口可能是環狀迴腸造口的替代選擇，具有較少的代謝併發症及相近的手術結果，但造口脫垂風險較高。

papers.title: Quality of Life and Ostomy Self-Care Ability Among Rectal Cancer Patients With Permanent Colostomy in Eastern and Western China: A Comparative Study
papers.journal_full: Journal of wound, ostomy, and continence nursing : official publication of The Wound, Ostomy and Continence Nurses Society
papers.authors: Chen X, Lv L, Zheng M, Huang M, Zhang J
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to compare health-related quality of life (QoL), ostomy self-care ability, and influencing factors among persons with permanent colostomies in 2 cities located in eastern versus western China.
DESIGN: Cross-sectional study.
SUBJECTS AND SETTING: Five hundred and fifteen patients with rectal cancer and a permanent colostomy were recruited from September 2013 to February 2016. Data were collected in the ostomy outpatient clinics of 3 grade A tertiary hospitals in Guangzhou, China (eastern China) and 2 grade A tertiary hospitals in Lanzhou, China (Western China).
METHODS: Participants completed a questionnaire that asked for demographic and pertinent stoma-related items designed for purposes of this study. They also completed the Stoma-QoL and Stoma Self-care Scale instruments. Participants were divided into 2 groups according to eastern and western geographical locations for intergroup comparative analysis.
RESULTS: There were significant differences between mean scores of Stoma-QoL (52.53 ± 12.72 vs. 41.86 ± 12.20; P < .001) and ostomy self-care abilities (38.03 ± 6.86 vs. 30.25 ± 9.84; P < .001) between patients in eastern and western China, respectively. Age, employment status, body image loss, acceptance of ostomy by patients themselves and their spouses, professional support from enterostomal/WOC nurses, and ostomy self-care ability were significant factors associated with Sitoma-QoL, accounting for 51.8% of the variance.
CONCLUSIONS: Stoma-QoL and ostomy self-care ability among patients with permanent colostomy in eastern China were generally better than those in western China. Effective measures should be taken to improve the QoL of patients with colostomy in western China.

papers.abstract_zh:
目的：本研究旨在比較中國東部與西部兩座城市中，永久性結腸造口者的健康相關生活品質（QoL）、造口自我照護能力及其影響因素。
研究設計：橫斷面研究。
研究對象與場域：於2013年9月至2016年2月招募515名罹患直腸癌且接受永久性結腸造口的病人。資料收集地點為中國廣州（中國東部）3家三級甲等醫院，以及蘭州（中國西部）2家三級甲等醫院的造口門診。
方法：參與者填寫為本研究設計的問卷，內容涵蓋人口學資料及相關造口項目；另外也完成造口生活品質量表（Stoma-QoL）與造口自我照護量表（Stoma Self-care Scale）。依東部與西部地理位置將參與者分為兩組，進行組間比較分析。
結果：中國東部與西部病人的Stoma-QoL平均分數分別為52.53 ± 12.72與41.86 ± 12.20（P < .001），造口自我照護能力平均分數分別為38.03 ± 6.86與30.25 ± 9.84（P < .001），兩項組間差異均達統計顯著。年齡、就業狀態、身體形象受損、病人本人及其配偶對造口的接受程度、腸造口／傷口造口失禁護理師提供的專業支持，以及造口自我照護能力，均為與Stoma-QoL顯著相關的因素，可解釋51.8%的變異。
結論：中國東部永久性結腸造口病人的Stoma-QoL與造口自我照護能力，整體而言優於中國西部病人。應採取有效措施，改善中國西部結腸造口病人的生活品質。

papers.title: Immune-epithelial coordination of barrier repair in inflammatory bowel disease: from cell survival to functional healing
papers.abstract: Epithelial repair in inflammatory bowel disease involves preservation of viable cells, coverage of wounds, renewal of epithelial populations and recovery of selective transport and secretion. These processes overlap, yet improvement in one does not establish completion of the others. This narrative review examines how immune signals influence these transitions and how experimental repair findings relate to patient outcomes. We first describe the junctional and mucus barrier and the distinction between physiological, endoscopic and histological measurements. We then examine epithelial death control, regenerative pathways and immune-derived signals using studies selected for compartment-specific perturbation, functional measurements or informative discrepancies between experimental and clinical findings. Interleukin-22 illustrates the importance of context: it promotes regeneration in several experimental systems, disrupts barrier function in a human colon chip, and has not yielded demonstrated efficacy as efmarodocokin alfa in a phase II ulcerative colitis trial. In one small infliximab study, paired measurements from nine patients showed an increase in epithelial resistance after treatment. Larger controlled studies are needed to establish how consistently functional recovery accompanies immune control. We organize the evidence around target engagement, epithelial response, barrier function and patient benefit, with example assays and common interpretive pitfalls for each. The resulting synthesis identifies the measurements needed to distinguish protection from repair and to test whether an epithelial effect adds value to effective immune therapy. Clinical studies must ultimately establish that a specified functional improvement is durable and beneficial to patients.
papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病中屏障修復的免疫—上皮協調：從細胞存活到功能性癒合
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病中的上皮修復，涉及保存存活細胞、覆蓋傷口、更新上皮細胞群，以及恢復選擇性運輸與分泌功能。這些過程彼此重疊，但其中一項改善，並不代表其他過程已完成。本敘述性綜述探討免疫訊號如何影響這些轉變，以及實驗中的修復發現如何與病人結局相互連結。我們首先描述細胞連結與黏液屏障，以及生理、內視鏡和組織學測量之間的差異。接著，我們根據針對特定區室進行干預、採用功能性測量，或呈現實驗與臨床發現間具啟發性差異而選取的研究，探討上皮細胞死亡調控、再生路徑及免疫來源訊號。介白素-22（IL-22）說明了情境的重要性：它在數種實驗系統中促進再生，卻在人類結腸晶片中破壞屏障功能，而以 efmarodocokin alfa 形式用於潰瘍性結腸炎第二期試驗時，也尚未證實療效。在一項小型 infliximab 研究中，9 名病人的配對測量顯示治療後上皮電阻增加。需要更大型的對照研究，才能確立功能恢復伴隨免疫控制出現的一致程度。我們以標的作用確認、上皮反應、屏障功能及病人獲益為架構整理證據，並針對各項提供檢測範例與常見的詮釋陷阱。此綜合整理指出，區分保護與修復，以及檢驗上皮作用是否能在有效免疫治療之外帶來額外價值，所需進行的測量。臨床研究最終必須確立，某項明確的功能改善是否持久，且對病人有益。

papers.title: Nutrition in the Era of Incretin-Based Therapies: Clinical Strategies for Optimizing Care
papers.authors: Gold S, Pearlman M, Pandey A, Mundi M, McClave S
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: To review current evidence and practical nutrition strategies for patients receiving incretin-based therapies, including glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP)/GLP-1 receptor agonists, with a focus on nutritional adequacy, body composition, gastrointestinal tolerance, and long-term adherence.
RECENT FINDINGS: Incretin-based therapies have transformed obesity treatment by producing substantial weight loss and cardiometabolic improvement. However, these therapies are also associated with reduced oral intake, gastrointestinal adverse effects, lean mass loss, and potential micronutrient inadequacy, highlighting the need for comprehensive nutritional management. Emerging evidence supports individualized dietary strategies to improve tolerance and maintain nutritional status, including targeted approaches for constipation, diarrhea, nausea, and reflux, as well as considerations for special populations such as pati​ents with inflammatory bowel disease, short bowel syndrome, gastroesophageal reflux disease, and pediatric obesity. Nutrition care is a critical component of treatment with incretin-based therapies. Individualized dietary strategies may help preserve lean body mass, optimize nutrient intake, reduce gastrointestinal side effects, and support long-term adherence and clinical outcomes.

papers.title: PET-CT in Esophageal, Gastric, and Colorectal Malignancies
papers.journal: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am
papers.journal_full: Magnetic resonance imaging clinics of North America
papers.abstract: This review evaluates the integration of PET-computed tomography (CT) in the management of esophageal, gastric, and colorectal malignancies. While anatomical imaging remains the standard for T-staging, PET-CT provides superior accuracy in identifying occult metastases and monitoring therapeutic response. The article also covers the prognostic utility of semiquantitative PET metrics, such as standard uptake value, metabolic tumor volume, and total lesion glycolysis. The potential of novel tracers such as fibroblast activation protein inhibitors to address limitations of fluorodeoxyglucose in specific circumstances is also discussed. Ultimately, PET-CT allows precision in oncology by refining diagnostic accuracy and individualizing therapeutic interventions.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of endoscopic submucosal dissection for lesions originating from the anal canal: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Nasr E, Ismaiel M, Abosheisha M, Prabhu R, Alqasem M, Kandeel M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anal canal lesions (ACLs) represent a significant clinical challenge requiring consideration of sphincter function preservation. Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is a promising minimally invasive technique for en bloc resection, yet its application in the anal canal is technically demanding due to the narrow lumen and somatic innervation. We conducted this meta-analysis to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ESD for ACLs.
METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science through February 2026. Eligible studies involved adult patients undergoing ESD for lesions originating in the anal canal. Primary outcomes were en bloc and R0 resection rates. Secondary outcomes included complications and local recurrence. Pooled proportions were calculated using random-effects models.
RESULTS: Four retrospective studies involving 150 patients were included. The pooled en bloc resection rate was 94.1% (95% CI: 89.6%-97.4%). The R0 resection rate was 84.8% (95% CI: 78.7%-90.0%). Safety analysis revealed pooled incidences of anal pain at 18.7% (95% CI: 0.0%-60.0%), delayed bleeding at 6.6% (95% CI: 1.1%-16.1%), and anal stenosis at 1.1% (95% CI: 0.0%-3.7%). The pooled local recurrence rate was 4.7% (95% CI: 0.6%-12.3%). Median follow-up for the studies ranged from 9 to 37 months.
CONCLUSION: In experienced centers, ESD appears to be a feasible and promising organ-preserving approach for anal canal lesions, achieving high en bloc and R0 resection rates with low early recurrence. Comparative and longer-term data would help define its role relative to surgical excision or repeated ablative therapies.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：肛管病灶（ACLs）是重要的臨床挑戰，治療時須考量括約肌功能的保留。內視鏡黏膜下剝離術（ESD）是一種具有潛力、可達整塊切除的微創技術，但肛管管腔狹窄且具有體神經支配，使其應用在技術上相當困難。我們進行本統合分析，以評估ESD治療肛管病灶的療效與安全性。
方法：依循PRISMA指引，我們搜尋PubMed、Scopus及Web of Science，檢索截至2026年2月的文獻。符合資格的研究納入因源自肛管的病灶而接受ESD的成年患者。主要結果為整塊切除率與R0切除率。次要結果包括併發症與局部復發。使用隨機效應模型計算合併比例。
結果：共納入4篇回溯性研究，包含150名患者。合併整塊切除率為94.1%（95%信賴區間：89.6%–97.4%）。R0切除率為84.8%（95%信賴區間：78.7%–90.0%）。安全性分析顯示，肛門疼痛的合併發生率為18.7%（95%信賴區間：0.0%–60.0%），延遲出血為6.6%（95%信賴區間：1.1%–16.1%），肛門狹窄為1.1%（95%信賴區間：0.0%–3.7%）。合併局部復發率為4.7%（95%信賴區間：0.6%–12.3%）。各研究的追蹤時間中位數介於9至37個月。
結論：在具經驗的中心，ESD似乎是治療肛管病灶可行且具潛力的器官保留方式，可達到高整塊切除率與R0切除率，且早期復發率低。比較性研究及更長期的資料，將有助於釐清其相較於外科切除或反覆消融治療的定位。

papers.title: Quadratus lumborum versus transversus abdominis plane block for postoperative analgesia in laparoscopic colorectal surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.authors: Moqbel I, Elshabrawi M, Tawadros M, Abdelmeguid A, Shereer F, Ei Hilali A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Effective pain management after surgery is crucial for recovery following laparoscopic colorectal resection in enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) programs. While the transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block is commonly used, it may not fully address visceral pain. The quadratus lumborum (QL) block might provide better coverage for both somatic and visceral pain due to its ability to spread to the thoracolumbar fascia and paravertebral space.
OBJECTIVES: This study aims to compare the clinical outcomes of QL versus TAP blocks in laparoscopic colorectal surgery. The main outcome was total opioid use within 24 h. Secondary outcomes included early pain scores, time until the first rescue analgesic was needed, postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), length of stay, surgical complications, and side effects related to the blocks.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic literature search using PubMed, Cochrane CENTRAL, Web of Science Core Collection, and Scopus from database inception to 27 July 2025 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing QL and TAP blocks. Two reviewers independently screened the studies, extracted data, and assessed quality using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. We calculated pooled estimates using a random-effects model and evaluated the reliability of the evidence on the basis of the grading of recommendations, assessment, development, and evaluation (GRADE) framework.
RESULTS: Four RCTs (n = 419) met the inclusion criteria. Compared with the TAP block, the QL block led to lower opioid use within 24 h (MD [mean difference] -8.92 mg morphine equivalents; 95% CI -11.57 to -6.28) and reduced pain scores both at rest MD -0.25 (-0.37 to -0.21) and during movement MD -0.40 [-0.52 to -0.29]. Operative time numerically favored the QL block, but the pooled difference was not statistically significant. The rates of PONV (OR 0.54; 95% CI 0.25-1.19) and dizziness (OR 0.60; 95% CI 0.22-1.63) were not significantly different between the two groups. The evidence was rated high for PONV and operative time, and moderate for opioid consumption, pain at rest, pain during movement, and dizziness, reflecting downgrades for imprecision and, for opioid consumption and pain during movement, substantial-to-high heterogeneity (I2 85% and 93%, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: In laparoscopic colorectal surgery, the QL block shows better opioid-sparing effects and lower pain scores at rest and during movement than the TAP block. Operative time numerically favored the QL block but did not differ significantly between groups. Importantly, it does not lead to more adverse effects. These findings suggest that the QL block may be a useful opioid-sparing option within ERAS-based perioperative care, although larger multicenter RCTs are needed before routine preference over the TAP block can be firmly recommended.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：在術後加速康復（ERAS）計畫中，有效的術後疼痛控制對腹腔鏡大腸直腸切除術後恢復至關重要。腹橫肌平面（TAP）阻斷雖然經常使用，但可能無法充分處理內臟疼痛。腰方肌（QL）阻斷因藥物可擴散至胸腰筋膜與椎旁空間，可能對體壁及內臟疼痛提供更好的涵蓋。
目的：本研究旨在比較QL與TAP阻斷用於腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術的臨床結果。主要結果為24小時內鴉片類藥物總使用量。次要結果包括早期疼痛評分、首次需要救援止痛藥的時間、術後噁心嘔吐（PONV）、住院天數、手術併發症，以及阻斷相關副作用。
方法：我們系統性搜尋PubMed、Cochrane CENTRAL、Web of Science Core Collection及Scopus，搜尋期間自各資料庫建置起至2025年7月27日，納入比較QL與TAP阻斷的隨機對照試驗（RCT）。兩位審查者獨立篩選研究、擷取資料，並使用Cochrane偏倚風險評估工具第2版（RoB 2）評估品質。我們以隨機效應模型計算合併估計值，並依據建議分級、評估、發展與評價（GRADE）架構評估證據的可信度。
結果：共有4項RCT（n＝419）符合納入條件。相較於TAP阻斷，QL阻斷降低24小時內鴉片類藥物使用量〔平均差（MD）為−8.92 mg嗎啡當量；95%信賴區間（CI）−11.57至−6.28〕，並降低靜息時疼痛評分〔MD −0.25（−0.37至−0.21）〕及活動時疼痛評分〔MD −0.40（−0.52至−0.29）〕。手術時間在數值上有利於QL阻斷，但合併差異未達統計顯著。兩組的PONV發生率（OR 0.54；95% CI 0.25–1.19）與頭暈發生率（OR 0.60；95% CI 0.22–1.63）均無顯著差異。PONV及手術時間的證據確定性評為高；鴉片類藥物使用量、靜息時疼痛、活動時疼痛及頭暈則評為中等。降級原因包括估計不精確，以及鴉片類藥物使用量與活動時疼痛存在顯著至高度異質性，兩者I²分別為85%及93%。
結論：在腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術中，QL阻斷較TAP阻斷具有更佳的鴉片類藥物節省效果，且靜息與活動時疼痛評分較低。手術時間在數值上有利於QL阻斷，但組間差異未達顯著。重要的是，QL阻斷並未導致更多不良反應。這些結果顯示，QL阻斷可能是ERAS導向圍手術期照護中可用的鴉片類藥物節省選項，但在能夠明確建議常規優先採用QL而非TAP阻斷之前，仍需要更大型的多中心RCT。

papers.title: Fecal microbiota transplantation for pediatric Clostridioides difficile infection: efficacy, challenges, and the path to next-generation microbiome therapies
papers.authors: Nicholson M, Conrad M, Diaz De Leon S, Strength R, Kelsen J, Kahn S
papers.abstract: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) is an increasing cause of morbidity in children, with recurrent disease posing substantial therapeutic challenges. Antibiotic therapy remains the cornerstone of initial management; however, up to 30% of children experience recurrence, and those with underlying comorbidities face recurrence rates as high as 65%. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) has demonstrated superior efficacy over antibiotics for recurrent CDI (rCDI) in adults and has emerged as the most effective available intervention for pediatric rCDI. In this review, we synthesize current evidence on FMT efficacy, microbiome changes, and safety in children with CDI. Data from large multicenter cohort studies demonstrate cure rates exceeding 80%, with comparable efficacy observed in high-risk subpopulations, including those with inflammatory bowel disease and immunocompromising conditions. Critical research gaps remain, including the absence of randomized controlled trials and limited long-term safety data in children. Despite demonstrated effectiveness, significant barriers limit FMT accessibility for children. The COVID-19 pandemic has substantially impacted availability, and current regulatory changes have further restricted access. The lack of FDA-approved live biotherapeutic products approved for CDI in children creates additional challenges. We critically examine the emerging pipeline of next-generation microbiome-based therapies and identify the steps required to ensure children with recurrent CDI have access to safe, effective, and approved treatments.

papers.title: Epitranscriptomic RNA modifications in cancer DNA damage response: mechanistic links between RNA fate, genome maintenance, and therapy resistance
papers.authors: Yang X, Wang H, He J, Yang S, Zhao M, Zhao L
papers.abstract: Epitranscriptomic RNA modifications have emerged as a fundamental regulatory layer linking RNA metabolism with genome maintenance, DNA damage response (DDR), and therapeutic resistance during cancer evolution. Throughout tumorigenesis, persistent oncogenic signaling, replication stress, oxidative stress, metabolic reprogramming, chronic inflammation, and anticancer treatments continuously generate DNA lesions that challenge genome integrity. Although the DDR network normally safeguards genomic stability by coordinating DNA damage sensing, checkpoint activation, and repair pathway selection, established cancer cells frequently hijack these protective mechanisms to survive radiotherapy, platinum-based chemotherapy, poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors, and other genotoxic therapies. Increasing evidence indicates that epitranscriptomic regulation is an integral component of the DDR rather than merely a downstream consequence of DNA damage. RNA modifications dynamically coordinate transcript stability, RNA processing, translation, alternative splicing, R-loop homeostasis, DNA: RNA hybrid dynamics, repair factor recruitment, metabolic adaptation, replication stress tolerance, and cell-cycle checkpoint activation, thereby reshaping cellular responses to genotoxic stress. Importantly, accumulating evidence suggests that RNA modifications rarely function through isolated signaling pathways. Instead, distinct epitranscriptomic marks converge on shared biological processes that collectively determine genome stability, DNA repair capacity, and therapeutic responsiveness. In this Review, we provide a comprehensive overview of how RNA modifications remodel the DDR throughout cancer evolution, with particular emphasis on cancer type-specific mechanisms rather than conventional modification-based classification. We discuss recent advances across multiple malignancies, including lung cancer, breast cancer, ovarian cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, glioblastoma, bladder cancer, colorectal cancer, pancreatic cancer, osteosarcoma, and other solid tumors. Furthermore, we critically evaluate the current evidence supporting individual regulatory mechanisms, distinguish well-established causal pathways from observations that remain largely correlative or context-dependent, and highlight unresolved controversies that continue to limit clinical translation. Finally, we discuss the major conceptual and technical challenges facing the field and propose future directions for integrating the RNA modification-DDR axis into precision oncology.

papers.abstract_zh: 表觀轉錄體 RNA 修飾已成為一個重要的調控層次，在癌症演化過程中連結 RNA 代謝、基因組維護、DNA 損傷反應（DDR）及治療抗性。在腫瘤生成的整個過程中，持續的致癌訊號、複製壓力、氧化壓力、代謝重編程、慢性發炎及抗癌治療，會不斷造成 DNA 損傷，威脅基因組完整性。雖然 DDR 網絡通常會透過協調 DNA 損傷感知、檢查點活化及修復路徑選擇，來維護基因組穩定性，但已形成的癌細胞經常挪用這些保護機制，以在放射治療、鉑類化學治療、聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制劑及其他基因毒性治療下存活。愈來愈多證據顯示，表觀轉錄體調控是 DDR 不可或缺的一環，而不只是 DNA 損傷的下游結果。RNA 修飾會動態協調轉錄本穩定性、RNA 加工、轉譯、選擇性剪接、R-loop 恆定、DNA：RNA 雜合體動態、修復因子招募、代謝適應、複製壓力耐受性，以及細胞週期檢查點活化，進而重塑細胞對基因毒性壓力的反應。重要的是，累積證據顯示，RNA 修飾很少透過彼此孤立的訊息傳遞路徑發揮作用。相反地，不同的表觀轉錄體標記會匯聚於共同的生物學過程，協同決定基因組穩定性、DNA 修復能力及治療反應性。在本篇綜述中，我們全面概述 RNA 修飾如何在癌症演化過程中重塑 DDR，並特別著重於癌別特異性的機轉，而非依循傳統以修飾種類為基礎的分類方式。我們討論多種惡性腫瘤的近期進展，包括肺癌、乳癌、卵巢癌、肝細胞癌、膠質母細胞瘤、膀胱癌、大腸直腸癌、胰臟癌、骨肉瘤及其他實體腫瘤。此外，我們批判性評估支持個別調控機轉的現有證據，區分已充分確立的因果路徑，以及仍主要屬於相關性或依賴特定情境的觀察結果，並指出持續限制臨床轉譯的未解爭議。最後，我們討論此領域面臨的主要概念與技術挑戰，並提出未來將 RNA 修飾–DDR 軸整合至精準腫瘤學的方向。

papers.title: Optimizing cold resection for colorectal polyps: insights from diminutive to large polyps
papers.authors: Shang H, Zhang R, Song W, Wang J, Wang J
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to review the clinical application of cold resection for colorectal polyps and determine its efficacy and safety for polyps of different sizes.
METHODS: A narrative review was conducted to analyze and compare key indicators, including complete resection rate (CRR), bleeding rate, perforation rate, and recurrence rate, for polyps of different sizes undergoing cold versus hot resection.
RESULTS: The CRR of cold snare polypectomy (CSP) for resecting colorectal polyps measuring ≤ 10 mm is comparable to that of hot resection. However, the risk of delayed bleeding and perforation is significantly lower with CSP. With nonpedunculated colorectal polyps measuring 10-19 mm, particularly sessile serrated lesions (SSLs), cold resection (e.g., piecemeal cold snare polypectomy (pCSP)) is a safe and feasible option. For colorectal adenomas, however, the risk of recurrence with cold resection may be slightly higher than with hot resection. For large (≥ 20 mm) sessile serrated lesions (L-SSLs), cold resection offers significant safety advantages; however, the risk of recurrence is higher than with hot resection. Due to the higher risk of recurrence, cold resection is not recommended for removing large (≥ 20 mm) nonpedunculated adenomatous polyps (LNPCPs). Cold resection is particularly suitable for patients taking anticoagulants and those in poor health who cannot tolerate complications.
CONCLUSIONS: Cold resection has become the standard treatment for small polyps due to its excellent safety profile. It is now also used for some larger polyps, particularly SSLs. However, strict adherence to histology guidance is crucial for larger polyps and adenomatous lesions because of the higher rate of postoperative recurrence.

papers.title_zh: 優化大腸直腸息肉的冷切除：從微小到大型息肉的臨床見解
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：本研究旨在回顧冷切除於大腸直腸息肉的臨床應用，並判定其對不同大小息肉的療效與安全性。
方法：進行敘述性綜述，分析並比較不同大小息肉接受冷切除與熱切除的關鍵指標，包括完整切除率（CRR）、出血率、穿孔率及復發率。
結果：對於≤10 mm的大腸直腸息肉，冷圈套息肉切除術（CSP）的CRR與熱切除相當。然而，CSP的延遲性出血及穿孔風險顯著較低。對於10–19 mm的無蒂大腸直腸息肉，尤其是無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（SSL），冷切除，例如分片冷圈套息肉切除術（pCSP），是安全且可行的選擇。然而，對於大腸直腸腺瘤，冷切除的復發風險可能略高於熱切除。對於大型（≥20 mm）無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（L-SSL），冷切除具有顯著的安全性優勢；然而，其復發風險高於熱切除。由於復發風險較高，不建議以冷切除移除大型（≥20 mm）無蒂腺瘤性息肉（LNPCP）。冷切除特別適合正在服用抗凝血藥物，以及健康狀況不佳、無法承受併發症的患者。
結論：冷切除因其優異的安全性，已成為小型息肉的標準治療。目前也應用於部分較大的息肉，尤其是SSL。然而，對於較大的息肉及腺瘤性病灶，由於術後復發率較高，嚴格依循組織學特性指導治療至關重要。
